Name: AhCuteArt's Colored Themed Flooring Paths
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5]AhCuteArt's Colored Theme Project[/size][/b]

I am working on retexturing a bunch of assets with colored themes. Why? Because I like to play some of my saves with color themes in mind. I looked around on Nexus and couldn't find the colored retextures I was looking for, so I decided to make my own. I plan to make more mods like this in the future. I hope those of you who enjoy decorating find these mods useful. 

This is my first time making an AT file. I am crossing my fingers that there aren't any bugs. But if you guys find any issues, please let me know. 

I made major edits to the Straw Flooring. I tried to make the Crystal paths shine... well, like crystals. I also make a few minor edits here and there. BUT these paths are close to vanilla's designs or just recolors. 

[b]Current Colors: Black, Blue, Red, White, Green, Grey, Orange, Purple, Yellow, Babyblue, Buttermilk, Lilac, Marigold, Mint, and Pink[/b][b]
[/b]
[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Content Patcher):
[/b]
1. ﻿Choose one of the files or both. (Both the CP and AT files work together or separately) 
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]
There are Two files:[/b]
[CP File] This file will change all the flooring paths into a single themed color. Go into the GMCM and look for [b][i](CP) AhCuteArt Colored Flooring[/i][/b] to change the flooring and path options. 

[AT File] This file will change flooring squares into whatever themed colors you want. Make sure to buy the paint bucket from Robin to be able to edit your flooring and paths. 

[b][size=4]Compatibility:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This should work in every language. (I hope)
[*]Let me know if there is a mod that clashes with mine, and I'll try to fix it. But just assume that if you have another mod that edits flooring and paths, my CP mod might not work. The AT file should be fine with anything. 
[/list]
[b][size=4][u]Color Themed Projects:[/u]
[/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43118]AhCuteArt's Color Themed Torches
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43259]AhCuteArt's Ultimate Vanilla Fence Edits
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43412]AhCuteArt's Color Themed Horse Mounts
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43825]AhCuteArt Color Themed Fairy Royalty[/url]﻿

[i][b][i][b]Want different colors or themes?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If there is a color you want or a theme you would like to see done, feel free to request it, and I'll add it when I get the time.  [/i][/i]


[i][b][i][b]What am I working on?:[/b][/i]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media page or my Nexus profile. [/i][/i]
